ITEM 1 | Dark green leafy greens, flat broad leaves with visible veins and pale stems, mostly fresh and slightly glossy, spread in a loose mound covering roughly 35% of the plate's left-center area, about 12 cm across and 2 cm tall at the thickest point, with a few thin red-orange pepper or tomato pieces scattered through and small pale translucent sliced strips underneath | 90
ITEM 2 | Shredded pale white and off-white crisp strips mixed with thin bright orange carrot matchsticks, moist and slightly glossy with a crumbly, loosely packed texture, forming a mound about 8 cm by 6 cm and about 2.5 cm tall on the right side of the plate, with tiny flecks of golden grated material mixed in | 85
ITEM 3 | Thin pale translucent slivers and small red pepper pieces lying among the greens at the base of the leaf mound, flat and limp, sitting directly on the plate surface, covering about 5% of the plate | 8
